hearing_screening.label: Newborn Hearing Screening
hearing_screening.program: New Hampshire Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI) Program
hearing_screening.state_form_note: Hearing screening refusal uses the same refusal form from NH DHHS. NH mandates hearing screening; refusal documented on the form.
